speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that history. To better understand your condition, can you describe the appearance of your rash and whether it has ever been biopsied? Additionally, are you experiencing any other systemic symptoms like joint pain or fatigue?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of photosensitive blistering rash on sun-exposed areas (face, hands), pruritus, and neuropathy (numbness/tingling) in a rice farmer suggests hepatic porphyria, likely exacerbated by dietary or herbal factors. REQUEST TEST: Serum porphyrins, urine porphobilinogen, and liver function panel.
